# Droid fixtures

No Droid installation was available when this provider was written, so the file is
`synthetic_`, built from the `*.settings.json` shape ccusage's reader documents. Replace with
a real session settings file before release (`docs/USER_ACTIONS.md`).

| File | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `synthetic_session.settings.json` | A session's running `tokenUsage` with a display-label model name |
